stops.date_confidence: The date is attested by Polish Wikipedia, which says he was shot in the Kuibyshev prison without trial on 17 February 1943, and by Russian Wikipedia. It is NOT attested by the Congress for Jewish Culture lexicon, which the dossier cited for it: refetched, that lexicon says the opposite, that both men were arrested in Kuibyshev and shot in December 1941, initially reported as December 1942. The lexicon is therefore a witness for the Soviet cover story rather than against it. The Litvinov communication of 23 February 1943 is attested by English Wikipedia and by Glotzer.

stops.segment: Kuibyshev, and the Grave With Nothing In It
stops.date_confidence: Attested. The unveiling of the symbolic grave on 17 April 1988 at the Okopowa Street Jewish Cemetery is given by English Wikipedia on both men and corroborated by Polish Wikipedia on both; English Wikipedia adds the crowd of more than three thousand and the Edelman and Solidarity involvement. Coordinates corrected to the Nominatim value for the cemetery; the dossier carried two different values, each roughly a kilometre off.

stops.segment: Kuibyshev, and the Grave With Nothing In It
stops.date_confidence: A real conflict, flagged and not resolved. Polish Wikipedia gives rehabilitation by the Prosecutor's Office of the USSR on 13 November 1990, the date used here; English Wikipedia gives 8 February 1991 and attributes it to President Yeltsin, which is anachronistic, since Yeltsin was not elected President of Russia until 12 June 1991 and a February 1991 act would have been a Soviet one. The Polish version is the more internally coherent; the English date is recorded, its attribution is not repeated as attested.
